name: Zinc picolinate
description: Zinc picolinate ( CAS 17949-65-4 ) is a zinc salt of picolinic acid used as a bioavailable zinc source in nutritional and functional product formulations. Its chelated structure supports efficient zinc delivery compared to inorganic zinc salts. This makes it a preferred choice for supplement manufacturers and formulators targeting mineral fortification. In dietary supplements, it is used to deliver elemental zinc in capsule, tablet, and powder formats where absorption efficiency is a key criterion. Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into topical products such as anti-acne creams and scalp treatments. In these applications, zinc's antimicrobial and sebum-regulating activity is the primary functional target for the formulation. In animal nutrition, it serves as a chelated zinc source in premixes and compound feeds. It supports skin integrity, immune function, and reproductive performance in livestock across various agricultural sectors. Pharmaceutical formulators use it in nutraceutical and OTC product development where a well-tolerated, organic zinc form is specified. The material is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder for industrial use. Standard grades include food-grade and feed-grade specifications, with pharmaceutical-grade material available for regulated applications. Quality is maintained according to USP and FCC standards to ensure high purity. Bulk supply is typically offered in kilogram and metric-ton quantities to meet global manufacturing demands.
